description: A small 1D convolutional neural network that reads a SPHEREx quick-look spectrum (102 channels, 0.75-5.0 um) and says which of seven kinds of object it looks most like.

classes.name: hot star
classes.long: Hot star (types O, B and A, hotter than 7,500 K)

classes.name: Sun-like star
classes.long: Sun-like star (types F, G and K, 3,900 to 7,500 K)

classes.name: cool star
classes.long: Cool star (type M, cooler than 3,900 K)

classes.name: brown dwarf
classes.long: Brown dwarf (types L, T and Y)

classes.name: young or dusty star
classes.long: Young or dusty star (young stellar objects, T Tauri and Herbig Ae/Be stars)

unusual.method: Mahalanobis distance in the network's penultimate layer, conformal p-value

split: Held-out sky tiles: no tile used for training appears in the test set.
data: SPHEREx DR1 spectral cube; labels from SIMBAD and Gaia DR3.
